acceptance: Reproduce first: export --anonymize on a text-plan companion with synthetic home and output-dir paths shows the leak before the fix.
anonymize_plans_payload sanitizes plan_text, plan_data.logical_plan, plan_data.optimized_plan and raw_explain_output using the shared detector, on a copy; input unchanged.
find_public_path_leaks is empty on the exported companion; fingerprints, keys, errors and variation fields are byte-identical to the input apart from the sanitized text.
CLI smoke: benchbox export --anonymize on a real Polars text companion and a real DuckDB DAG companion; outputs recorded in the PR body.
context:
Observed in publication hygiene investigation; helper omission re-read directly before filing. Preserve local private-export behavior where the user has not requested anonymization. No production republish or history rewriting authorized.

DECISIONS (owner, 2026-11-08): detector = known local roots (/Users, /home, /tmp, /var/folders, /private, /mnt, /opt, any Windows drive letter, UNC) PLUS the run's configured data and output directories, with an exact-rule placeholder allowlist (<redacted> and bare /data-style neutral placeholders); NOT every absolute path. Publish boundary = sanitize with the export anonymizer, re-scan, publish only if clean, otherwise reject with a redacted diagnostic and publish nothing (fail closed). ORDER: after the detector item. GUARDRAILS: stored fingerprints are never recomputed or altered by sanitizing text; plan structure, errors, fingerprint_varied/fingerprint_variants and keys are preserved; never mutate inputs in place; diagnostics must not print the leaked path values; no hosted data deletion, republish or history rewrite; private (non-anonymized) local exports keep their current behavior; false positives are bounded by an allowlist test that real plan text (catalog names, URLs, relative table tails, Spark/LakeSail scans) is not flagged. Verification rubric: (1) reproduce the defect with a failing test or script before editing; (2) focused suites pass via uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff on touched files; (4) the runtime smoke named in acceptance is recorded in the PR body; (5) one final batch PR merges with green CI and a passing oracle review.
description: anonymize_plans_payload strips plan.raw_explain_output and operator metadata but skips entry plan_text and nested plan_data.logical_plan/optimized_plan. Thus export --anonymize can retain local paths in legacy or externally supplied text-plan companions even after capture-time redaction was added. This is an export-boundary defect, distinct from the completed capture fix.
